name: Kilimanjaro · Moshi
tagline: The base for climbing Africa's highest peak
summary: Moshi is the town at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest mountain at 5,895 m. Most come to climb, but there are also coffee farms on the slopes, waterfalls, the hot springs of Chemka and views of the snow-capped peak at dawn.
seasonNote: Climbing seasons are January to March and June to October; avoid the long rains in April and May.
arrival: Kilimanjaro International Airport is about 45 minutes away.
gettingAround: Taxis and dala-dala minibuses; tours for trips.
cashTip: Safaris and park fees are usually paid in US dollars by card; carry shillings for tips and local shops. Prices here are in shillings.
foodTip: Chagga banana stew and Kilimanjaro coffee.
